parole.significato: actor (person who performs in a theatrical play or film)
parole.testo: Learned borrowing from Latin āctor. Noun sense 1 is a semantic loan from French acteur. First attested in 1587.
From alimenty + -ować, from Latin alimentum. Sense 1 is a semantic loan from French alimenter. First attested in 1686–1721.

parole.significato: ceremony, etiquette, ritual (set of socially accepted behaviours followed during formal occasions)
parole.testo: Learned borrowing from Latin caerimōniālis, possibly via French cérémonial.

parole.significato: generic (characteristic of or relating to a class or group of things; not specific)
parole.testo: From Latin genericus + -ny, possibly via French générique.

parole.significato: to explain (to make plain, manifest, or intelligible)
parole.testo: From przed- + kładać. Calque of Latin antepōnō. Sense 3 is a semantic loan from Latin prōpōnō, French proposer, and German vorlegen. First attested in 1522.

parole.significato: to explain (to make plain, manifest, or intelligible)
parole.testo: From przed- + łożyć. Calque of Latin antepōnō. Sense 2 is a semantic loan from Latin prōpōnō, French proposer, and German vorlegen.

parole.significato: radium (chemical element with an atomic number of 88)
parole.testo: Learned borrowing from New Latin radium.
